name: Verify Before Blocking on Ambiguous Signals
condition: Fraud probability < 0.70 or single weak alert indicator

name: Confirmed Fraud Card Blocking & Case Creation
condition: Fraud probability >= 0.70 or explicit customer denial of transaction

name: Legitimate Activity Dismissal
condition: Evidence confirms cardholder profile or customer confirms authorization

name: Out-of-Region Anomaly Verification
condition: Transaction billing region differs significantly from historical centroid

name: Card Testing Rapid Sequence Mitigation
condition: Sub-$5 micro-authorizations followed by sudden high-value velocity jump

name: Syndicate & Shared Device Protective Monitoring
condition: Device profile collisions connecting 3+ unrelated cards or customers

name: Account Takeover (ATO) Credential Restriction
condition: Password/profile changes followed immediately by high-risk transactions from new device

name: High-Value Exposure Human Escalation
condition: Ambiguous alert with exposure > $500 or confirmed exposure >= $1,000

name: Historical Fraud Pattern Recurrence
condition: Graph match against confirmed fraud outcomes in 5,565 closed cases memory

name: FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) Mandate
condition: Confirmed fraud exposure >= $1,000 or syndicate / ATO fraud typologies
